example-company.HWF_TOOL_CONTEXT: Use only locally authenticated Git and cloud contexts dedicated to this organization and the model/provider configured in the Hermes profile. Before first use in every task, verify the effective Git user and cloud account/tenant; block on mismatch. Never invoke another coding agent or CLI as a subprocess.
example-company.HWF_DEPLOY_POLICY: Agents never approve, merge, mutate infrastructure or deploy. The designated reviewer performs those actions.
example-company.HWF_SOURCE_SYSTEM: Cards originate in the organization's ticket system; links are context only and agents do not update it.
example-company.HWF_PR_POLICY: Write pull request titles and descriptions in the organization's language. Use the canonical documentation, backend, infrastructure or frontend template published by the organization; keep only relevant sections and justify an omission when it could cause ambiguity. Never expose internal orchestration, profiles, task IDs, executors, models, fallbacks or quotas in a public pull request.
